card.name: Volume units in infusion rates
card.fires_on: The unit word (mostly mL) right after a number when it starts a rate, just before "per minute", "/min" or "/hr". Also "cases" before "per 1,000".

modes.label: Infusion rate in mL
modes.description: mL after a number in a stated infusion or flow rate, before a per-time expression.
modes.example: The rate of intravenous infusion initially should be 2<< mL>>/min and may be increased gradually.

modes.label: Incidence rate
modes.description: The word cases after a number, before "per 1,000 patient" in an incidence figure.
modes.example: 11 cases of AML or MDS were identified, for an incidence of 0.32<< cases>> per 1,000 patient

card.writes: It pushes the model toward a "per" or "daily/weekly" style rate word coming next.
card.plain: It spots a number with a unit that is about to be turned into a rate, like mL per minute.
